sloka: अद्य हत्वा रणे यौ तौ मिथ्या प्रव्राजितौ वने।जयं पित्रे प्रदास्यामि रावणाय रणार्जितम् ।। ६.८०.१७ ।।
transliteration: adya hatvā raṇe yau tau mithyā pravrājitau vane।jayaṁ pitre pradāsyāmi rāvaṇāya raṇārjitam ।। 6.80.17 ।।

translations.english: "Having put an end to war, and the two princes who are in exile in the forest in vain, I will present the victory earned to my father now."
